task_title: Create waveshaper unit tests with DC offset and topology switch bounds
acceptance_criteria: tests/WaveshaperTests.cpp exists and defines juce::UnitTest cases (no third-party test framework used)
A test drives Asymmetric SD-1 clipping through the DcBlocker and asserts output mean is approximately 0 under asymmetric drive
A test switches voicing_mode and asserts sample-to-sample differences during the 15 ms crossfade stay within a click-free bound
CMakeLists.txt registers the WaveshaperTests source into the juce::UnitTest console runner target and via CTest add_test
cmake --build build --target ShredBoost_Tests succeeds and ctest --test-dir build -R Waveshaper passes
No file outside allowed_write_paths is created or modified
stdout:
Done. Summary of changes:

**`tests/WaveshaperTests.cpp`** (new) — pure `juce::UnitTest` cases registered under the `"Waveshaper"` category:
- **`WaveshaperDCOffsetTests`**: drives a 220 Hz sine through the Asymmetric SD-1 clipper (`NonlinearClipper` voicing_mode 2) then the `DcBlocker`, asserts the post-blocker output mean is below `5e-3`, and confirms the asymmetric clipper actually produced a measurable DC offset pre-blocker (so the test is meaningful).
- **`WaveshaperCrossfadeTests`**: processes a 330 Hz sine, flips `voicing_mode` from 1 (tanh) to 3 (passthrough) mid-stream, and asserts the worst-case sample-to-sample difference during the 720-sample (15 ms) crossfade stays within an absolute click bound (0.15) and within 2× of the steady-state diff. Also confirms the voicing actually changed (RMS differs) so the click-free claim isn't vacuous.

**`CMakeLists.txt`** — extended the existing `ShredBoostTests` juce::UnitTest console runner target (matching the existing FilterTests pattern, no third-party framework): added `tests/WaveshaperTests.cpp`, `Source/DSP/NonlinearClipper.cpp`, `Source/DSP/DcBlocker.cpp` to its sources, added `juce::juce_dsp` to its link list (required by the waveshaper headers), and registered `add_test(NAME WaveshaperTests COMMAND ShredBoostTests)` for CTest.

Verification:
- `cmake --build build --target ShredBoostTests` → built successfully.
- `ctest --test-dir build -R Waveshaper` → `WaveshaperTests Passed`.
- Full `ctest` suite (3 tests) → 100% passed, no regressions.
